rounds.sentence: Siku leri hi hanyaka eka rona i ____.
rounds.explain: Namuntlha i siku ra sweswi; mundzuku i siku leri taka.

rounds.sentence: Hi ta tlanga bolo ____ loko dyambu ri pela.
rounds.explain: Nimixo i loko dyambu ri ha huma; namadyambu i loko ri pela.

rounds.sentence: Loyi a vitanaka hi le rivaleni i ____?
rounds.explain: Mani yi vutisa munhu; yini yi vutisa nchumu.
Rini yi vula nkarhi; kwihi yi vula ndhawu.
Laha i kusuhi; kwalaho i le kule nyana.

rounds.sentence: ____ i dokodela wa muti wa hina.
rounds.explain: Loyi i munhu un'we; lava i vanhu vo tala.

rounds.sentence: Ndzi kombela u teka ____ etafuleni ra le kule.
rounds.explain: Leswi i swilo leswi kusuhi; sweswo i leswi nga le kule.
U yi famba na munhu un'we; va yi famba na vo tala.
Hi yi vula hina vo tala; ndzi i munhu un'we.
Muti wu teka wu; yi a yi faneli rito leri.
Ribye ri teka ri; yi yi fanela mavito man'wana.
Buku yi teka ya; ra a ri fambi na buku.
Xikolo xi teka xa; wa yi fanela mavito man'wana.
Swi yi fanela swilo swo tala; xi i nchumu wun'we.
Van'wana i vo tala; un'wana i munhu un'we.

kids.explain: Ehenhla i le henhla ka nchumu; ehansi i le hansi ka wona.
Ndzeni i endzeni ka yindlu; handle i ehandle.

kids.sentence: Ndzi nga ku khoma hikuva u le ____.
kids.explain: Kusuhi i ekusuhi; kule i ekule.
Endzhaku i le ndzhaku; emahlweni i le mahlweni.

kids.sentence: Bolo leyi i ____; ya tatana i yikulu.
kids.explain: Ntsongo i xilo lexitsongo; nkulu i lexikulu.
Basa swi vula ku tenga; thyaka a swi tenganga.

kids.sentence: Sopa leyi ya ____; yi dyiwe hi vukheta.
kids.explain: Hisa yi hisa; titimela yi titimela.

kids.sentence: Tawulo leri ri ha ____; a ri si oma.
kids.explain: Tsakamile a ri si oma; omile a ra ha ri na mati.

kids.sentence: Loko u heta ku nghena, ____ nyangwa.
kids.explain: Pfala i ku siva; pfula i ku pfula nchumu.
Hatlisa i ku hatla; nonoka i ku famba hi ku hlwela.
